title: Commercial
summary: COMMERCIAL, adjective 1. Pertaining to commerce or trade; as commercial concerns; commercial relations. 2. Carrying on commerce; as a commercial nation. 3. Proceeding from trade; as commercial benefit

inlines.v: COMMERCIAL, adjective 1. Pertaining to commerce or trade; as commercial concerns; commercial relations. 2. Carrying on commerce; as a commercial nation. 3. Proceeding from trade; as commercial benefits or profits.
